Title: Azure App Service Companion preview available for iOS

Body.Content:
On October 10, we released the preview for Azure App Service Companion to the Google Play Store. Today we're expanding the preview to iOS devices.

As with the Android version of the app, the focus is to provide the basic functionality that you need when you are on the go, without requiring you to use your laptop. And it's in a native experience for your device.

Read more in our blog.
